gaussian: Class score joint Gaussian induced by stored mu and Q-mu*mu.T; no shrinkage or data-dependent covariance tuning; clip only negative numerical eigenvalues, fail if eigenvalue below -1e-8.
primary: Fit-only terminal heads on static_pc encoder; original current identity split; current meta excluded from bank, transport, and fitting.
selector: Maximize equal-class hybrid accuracy (Gaussian old classes, observed current meta). Require mean old/current/tail changes >= -1e-12 and total gain > max(1e-8, 2*paired numerical integration SE). Tie lower index; no eligible head => zero.
original_reward_baseline: Same 17 terminal fit-only edge heads, same fit-only statistics, current meta, original penalties/KL/gate; not the previous pre-training reward.
simple_baseline: Column norm exponent tau=i/16, i=0..16, on the same zero-action fit head; same hybrid selector and protection rules.
secondary: Apply fit-selected action or norm tau to all-refit with no reselection; report every head only after all states selections are locked.
calibration: Current classes treated as statistics-only classes: fit Gaussian predictions versus held-out current meta. Descriptive and used for the closing recommendation, never to retune formulas or integration budgets in this run.
barrier: All three workers complete all five state selections before any development feature/metric read. Failed selection closes development for all workers.
stop: Complete frozen candidates and readouts, report all results and costs, publish, stop. No training, additional candidates, seeds, integration increase, covariance tuning or selection changes based on development.
